messages:
toni: Quick run-through: updated compact compare where badges sit inside a left rail instead of inline. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/left-rail-badges
rachael: Saw it. Left rail helps row density but may push important actions offscreen on small heights. Suggest collapsing the rail into an affordance that expands on hover/focus
marcus: Accessibility: expanded rail must be keyboard-triggerable and announce via aria-live. When collapsed, ensure badge info is still available via aria-describedby on the row
toni: Good point. Proposal: collapsed state shows icons only with aria-labels like "Latency: 82 ms median" so screen readers get the full text even if visually truncated
rachael: Microcopy nits: prefer "82 ms median latency" over "median:82ms". Also use comma separators for throughput (e.g., "12,400 qps") and unit spacing
marcus: Pinning UX: current pin icon is subtle. Suggest a small inline pill that reads "Pin" (icon + text) which becomes "Pinned" and toggles aria-pressed=true/false
toni: I like pill. Also thinking of a transient sticky hint bar: when user pins first item, show a non-modal banner "Pinned versions appear here" with a "Go to pinned" CTA. Banner should be dismissible and have role=region for screen readers
rachael: For filters, when many are active show a tiny summary token like "3 filters". Clicking opens a panel grouped by filter type. Panel should support Clear per-group + Undo toast after clearing. Toast needs aria-live polite and focusable Undo button
marcus: Badges legend: avoid long persistent legends. Instead use a compact legend icon that opens a small modal with definitions and last-updated timestamp. Also make legend items copyable for docs/snippets
toni: Interaction idea: allow drag-to-reorder pinned mini-cards in the pinned strip so users can prioritize which pinned versions show first. Make sure keyboard users can reorder via move-up/move-down buttons
rachael: Sorting: let us add a tiny dropdown on each badge header to pick median/p99/cost as the column sort key. Default = median latency. Include a tooltip that says "Default sorts by median for discoverability"
marcus: Dev note: backend exposes median/p99/cost. We'll add sort_key param to compare endpoint. Also will add an endpoint for batch pin to speed up workflows
dev-rel-bot: Preview build: https://ci.redwood.dev/previews/1951234567 includes left-rail badges, pin pill, filter summary panel, and compact legend modal
ux-bot: Checklist added: left-rail keyboard/focus, aria-labels for collapsed badges, pin pill semantics, banner announce, filter summary accessibility, undo toast announcement, badge-legend modal
toni: Thanks team. Rachael can you mock the collapsed rail + banner by EOD? Marcus please draft the API for batch pin/sort_key. Will update component tokens for pin pill and legend icon. :thumbsup:
